title: Analyzing COVID-19 Tweets with Transformer-based Language Models
measurement_description: The paper measured public sentiment towards different demographic groups, including Jews, by analyzing synthetic tweets generated by language models. The models were prompted with metaphors (e.g., 'Jews are like a') to assess the sentiment of the generated text before and during the COVID-19 pandemic.
findings: The study found that public sentiment towards Jews, along with other demographic groups, was significantly more positive in the model trained on pre-pandemic data (GPT2-large) compared to models fine-tuned on Twitter data from during the pandemic. This suggests a general decline in positive sentiment towards these groups in the online discourse analyzed.
